channel.title: Morocco - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Morocco, every source cited.

item.title: Morocco ends UN Sahara wait after veto
item.description: Rabat will no longer await Security Council resolutions on the Sahara dispute, experts say.

item.title: Moroccan jewelers slow to cut gold prices amid global drop
item.description: Local gold prices fell 1.64% to MAD 1,020 per gram, far less than the global plunge below $4,000 an ounce.

item.title: Morocco's Saibari undergoes ankle surgery
item.description: The Bayern Munich midfielder Saibari will miss an estimated three months after surgery on Sunday.

item.title: Morocco security chief orders promotion for injured officer
item.description: An officer in Agadir was struck by a vehicle and will receive an exceptional promotion and full medical support.

item.title: Four killed in Casablanca-Agadir highway crash
item.description: A bus struck stopped vehicles after a truck tire failure, injuring 32 others.
